name: Magic Fang, Greater Mass
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 5, summoner/unchained summoner 5

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Targets one living creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

This spell functions like greater magic fang, except that it affects multiple creatures.
